practiceName: Choose a suitable tool or approach
title: Failed draft retries through the real seam to ready-for-review
turnSequence: A generation request runs against the real PostgreSQL persistence with a provider that times out (deterministic fixture, per-call failure).
The record settles in failed-retryable with a retry offer.
The teacher retries the same request metadata with retryOfRequestId set; the provider now returns a valid draft (deterministic fixture).
expected: The retry is accepted on the same record: attempt increments, the new attempt links to the failed one, and the record reaches ready-for-review with a four-variant draft. The retry keeps the original request metadata so the idempotency lineage stays intact.
observableFailure: The retry is refused, the attempt counter does not advance, the retry loses the request metadata, or the record is duplicated instead of advanced.
flipCondition: Requires a migrated, seeded PostgreSQL reachable at DATABASE_URL; unblocks when the database is available.
